+        if max_resources is None and parent is not None:

+            parent._resource_tracker if parent is not None else _ResourceTracker()

+        rv = self._exit_stack.enter_context(context_manager)
+        # Count only once the resource is entered, so a failing
+        # ``__enter__`` does not use up part of the limit.
+        self._resource_tracker.count += 1
+        self._own_resource_count += 1

     def call_on_close(self, f: t.Callable[..., t.Any]) -> t.Callable[..., t.Any]:
